description: Returns the passages of the published comparison pages that answer, each with its page to quote, and the tools a page covers. Use it when the buyer compares this product with another tool or a kind of tool: Cuevr or PandaDoc, an alternative to Word, Cuevr or an e-signature tool. To know if it works with a tool already in use (keep Docusign, an integration): chercher; without a named tool: atouts. A tool no page covers is listed in nonCouverts: say nothing about it.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

question.description: The buyer's comparison in their words, with the tools named (e.g. Cuevr or PandaDoc for a team of 10).

name: comparer
title: Compare with another tool
